events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His impact on music and culture remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the iconic 'White Album'. Which track is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed their sound and influenced generations.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was tragically killed on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Passing
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the iconic British singer-songwriter, was born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose artistry knew no bounds.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Aaron Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', was born on January 8, 1935, in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: King's Birthday
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley and his timeless music.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and producer Jimmy Page was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs with Led Zeppelin changed rock music forever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Roderick David Stewart, the distinctive British singer-songwriter, was born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the one and only Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! What's your favourite hit from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, was born on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! His energy and iconic vocals are pure British joy.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English musician and singer-songwriter Paul Antony Young was born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals brought us some unforgettable hits in the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Dolly Rebecca Parton, the legendary American country music singer-songwriter, was born on January 19, 1946.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music, songwriting, and pure joy.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and lead vocalist of Take That, Gary Barlow, was born on January 20, 1971.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his incredible solo career, a true British music staple.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer and songwriter Billy Ocean was born Leslie Sebastian Charles on January 21, 1950.

angles.name: Soulful Sounds
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! His smooth vocals and unforgettable hits still get us moving.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 24, 1989, honouring pioneers of rock and roll.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Who were your favourite original inductees?
